recent.text: -- was coming to New York to do a -- to revisit -- sorry -- the tour of Robert, Sr., on hunger in America. And so they had planned a whole day of visits through the same areas of New York City that Robert Kennedy, Sr., had visited. And Ted Kennedy was carrying an antihunger bill in Congress at the time. And I was invited to come be with Ted Kennedy and, it turns out, Hazel Dukes, traveling the…

recent.title: Regular Session
recent.text: So Hazel Dukes had an enormous impact on me in one day in my life. It was the late 1980s. Ted Kennedy -- one of the good Kennedys -- (Laughter.)

recent.text: I'll continue it, if that's okay, because I have three minutes. So I was going to go down that same road, because I think it's overly optimistic that they would only cut us $15 billion at the rate they're going and the rapidity by which they all folded on $2 trillion cuts at the federal level the other night. So I'm just curious, because you're all tax experts. You don't have to answer it now, but…
